2293ee54-df62-55d0-bca5-8a40968d58cf.description:
## Bloodmap, 1 charge

- A blank leather parchment that absorbs any blood spilled on its surface before rolling into a tight scroll. Unroll to see a rough map revealing the current location of any remaining blood. The image disappears after a few minutes.
  - **Recharge**: Pour a pint of your own life essence onto the map, blood for blood. You are _deprived_ until you can rest and eat a Ration.

attributes.charge_regain: Pour a pint of your own life essence onto the map, blood for blood. You are _deprived_ until you can rest and eat a Ration.
attributes.effects: A blank leather parchment that absorbs any blood spilled on its surface before rolling into a tight scroll. Unroll to see a rough map revealing the current location of any remaining blood. The image disappears after a few minutes.

70e56572-264a-5374-bb86-d238ebfa7b6f.name: Coin of the Father, 1 charge, _petty_
70e56572-264a-5374-bb86-d238ebfa7b6f.description:
## Coin of the Father, 1 charge, _petty_

- Flip this worthless-looking hunk of flat metal in the air, and it will transform into d100 gold coins. The illusory coins disappear after one hour.
  - **Recharge**: Carry the coin for three days without spending or earning any money.

attributes.charge_regain: Carry the coin for three days without spending or earning any money.
attributes.effects: Flip this worthless-looking hunk of flat metal in the air, and it will transform into d100 gold coins. The illusory coins disappear after one hour.

4471f9a3-d81d-5fd1-be36-c5baf489a1fa.name: Dryad's Tear, 1 use
4471f9a3-d81d-5fd1-be36-c5baf489a1fa.description:
## Dryad's Tear, 1 use

- Shatter this crystal to merge with a tree you can touch. You can perceive the goings-on within whatever forest that tree belongs to.

attributes.effects: Shatter this crystal to merge with a tree you can touch. You can perceive the goings-on within whatever forest that tree belongs to.

e6f98159-7c68-532b-8cf7-d93dddff5c6c.name: Empathy Rod, 3 charges
e6f98159-7c68-532b-8cf7-d93dddff5c6c.description:
## Empathy Rod, 3 charges

- When two creatures touch this wooden pole at the same time, their physical and emotional states become fully intertwined until they let go.
  - **Recharge**: Give the rod to a former enemy as a gift. This is a one-way transaction.

attributes.charge_regain: Give the rod to a former enemy as a gift. This is a one-way transaction.
attributes.effects: When two creatures touch this wooden pole at the same time, their physical and emotional states become fully intertwined until they let go.

551d8374-ec2e-5da5-ae89-79496e89fa3b.name: Eyestone, 3 charges
551d8374-ec2e-5da5-ae89-79496e89fa3b.description:
## Eyestone, 3 charges

- Choose an object created by living creatures. You can sense the nearest example.
  - **Recharge**: Place in a bucket of rainwater overnight.

attributes.charge_regain: Place in a bucket of rainwater overnight.
attributes.effects: Choose an object created by living creatures. You can sense the nearest example.

ce334b45-938b-5ef6-ae40-bd00dc625888.name: Falconstone, 3 charges
ce334b45-938b-5ef6-ae40-bd00dc625888.description:
## Falconstone, 3 charges

- Perceive the world through the eyes and ears of a nearby bird of prey. You feel whatever it feels but have no control over it.
  - **Recharge**: Kill and eat a common quarry, cooking the meat alongside the stone.

attributes.charge_regain: Kill and eat a common quarry, cooking the meat alongside the stone.
attributes.effects: Perceive the world through the eyes and ears of a nearby bird of prey. You feel whatever it feels but have no control over it.

7c988798-7e1e-5cb7-8fcf-a0cfab5ba4fe.name: Footpad's Friend
7c988798-7e1e-5cb7-8fcf-a0cfab5ba4fe.description:
## Footpad's Friend

- Soft leather shoes that adapt to fit any foot size. Leave behind footprints that scatter and turn in a confusing manner, making tracking nigh-impossible.

attributes.effects: Soft leather shoes that adapt to fit any foot size. Leave behind footprints that scatter and turn in a confusing manner, making tracking nigh-impossible.

9366ba27-ce66-5c0c-a40b-fbe84febd432.name: Gate Chalk, 1 use, _petty_
9366ba27-ce66-5c0c-a40b-fbe84febd432.description:
## Gate Chalk, 1 use, _petty_

- Draw a doorway on any flat surface to open a one-way passage to the Roots. Good luck.

attributes.effects: Draw a doorway on any flat surface to open a one-way passage to the Roots. Good luck.

f54f0cce-78b6-528a-aa0f-65039ed46508.name: Golden Wheat Paste, 2 uses
f54f0cce-78b6-528a-aa0f-65039ed46508.description:
## Golden Wheat Paste, 2 uses

- When mixed with water, this substance chemically bonds any two objects.

attributes.effects: When mixed with water, this substance chemically bonds any two objects.

1d8d9a19-b1a4-5ea5-b021-774b72e46271.name: Gossip Box, 1 charge
1d8d9a19-b1a4-5ea5-b021-774b72e46271.description:
## Gossip Box, 1 charge

- Wind the crank to replay any sound made in the past day in your current location. Each crank goes back one hour.
  - **Recharge**: Successfully spread one falsehood in the presence of the box.

attributes.charge_regain: Successfully spread one falsehood in the presence of the box.
attributes.effects: Wind the crank to replay any sound made in the past day in your current location. Each crank goes back one hour.

c97a21ea-07c4-5aa9-8aab-bd30ce631271.name: Harbinger's Bell, 1 charge
c97a21ea-07c4-5aa9-8aab-bd30ce631271.description:
## Harbinger's Bell, 1 charge

- Hang at chest height to ring when danger is imminent.
  - **Recharge**: Melt and reforge. Each time, roll a d6. On a 1-2, it breaks forever.

attributes.charge_regain: Melt and reforge. Each time, roll a d6. On a 1-2, it breaks forever.
attributes.effects: Hang at chest height to ring when danger is imminent.

b2fa2023-4521-5328-94b8-c5ec436eb597.name: Homunculus Nail, 1 use, _petty_
b2fa2023-4521-5328-94b8-c5ec436eb597.description:
## Homunculus Nail, 1 use, _petty_

- Prick a finger with the pointy end and hammer into any small object to form a loyal servant [3 HP, 4 STR, 13 DEX, 5 WIL] completely devoted to you. If not destroyed, it will outlive you.

attributes.effects: Prick a finger with the pointy end and hammer into any small object to form a loyal servant [3 HP, 4 STR, 13 DEX, 5 WIL] completely devoted to you. If not destroyed, it will outlive you.

b08057e8-1197-53b5-b45d-f7cd20019fed.name: Honest Earworm, 1 use
b08057e8-1197-53b5-b45d-f7cd20019fed.description:
## Honest Earworm, 1 use

- A foul-smelling, pinky-sized worm that feeds on earwax by crawling into the ear canal of a sleeping person. The victim then loses the ability to lie for 1d4 hours.

attributes.effects: A foul-smelling, pinky-sized worm that feeds on earwax by crawling into the ear canal of a sleeping person. The victim then loses the ability to lie for 1d4 hours.

8a8ed22c-da16-5e20-a201-8b981392bd55.name: Jar of Ants
8a8ed22c-da16-5e20-a201-8b981392bd55.description:
## Jar of Ants

- Break to release a colony of fire ants [6 HP, 2 STR, 10 DEX, 1 WIL, bite (d10), _detachment_]. Consumes a ration every two days.

attributes.effects: Break to release a colony of fire ants [6 HP, 2 STR, 10 DEX, 1 WIL, bite (d10), _detachment_]. Consumes a ration every two days.

2f8b86ea-fb8c-547e-b216-76adece907dd.name: Last Breath (d6), 1 charge
2f8b86ea-fb8c-547e-b216-76adece907dd.description:
## Last Breath (d6), 1 charge

- A chipped short sword of dubious quality. Drive into the earth to form a crystal dome that encircles and immobilizes the wielder. The dome is impenetrable by mundane means, and shatters once the sword is lifted again.
  - **Recharge**: Deliver a killing blow with the sword, absorbing the dying victim's soul into the blade. There is a cunning intelligence within that speaks to the wielder, forever asking for more souls, more!

attributes.charge_regain: Deliver a killing blow with the sword, absorbing the dying victim's soul into the blade. There is a cunning intelligence within that speaks to the wielder, forever asking for more souls, more!
attributes.effects: A chipped short sword of dubious quality. Drive into the earth to form a crystal dome that encircles and immobilizes the wielder. The dome is impenetrable by mundane means, and shatters once the sword is lifted again.

95e7ca58-22b0-5ae8-b1b0-bad8ce53173f.name: Lightsucker Candle, 3 uses
95e7ca58-22b0-5ae8-b1b0-bad8ce53173f.description:
## Lightsucker Candle, 3 uses

- Once lit, this black tallow wax sheds darkness rather than light, even in the brightest of days.

attributes.effects: Once lit, this black tallow wax sheds darkness rather than light, even in the brightest of days.

2aa1c927-fe3a-5fe0-943a-963a874862a5.name: Lover's Covenant, 1 use
2aa1c927-fe3a-5fe0-943a-963a874862a5.description:
## Lover's Covenant, 1 use

- A bottle of red-tinted ink, a broken heart emblazoned on the front. Write up a contract of any length. Any who sign are bound to obey by penalty of death.

attributes.effects: A bottle of red-tinted ink, a broken heart emblazoned on the front. Write up a contract of any length. Any who sign are bound to obey by penalty of death.

39321d16-359d-5e2f-95ab-b9760eab5e27.name: Mace of the Kingslayer (d8), 2 charges
39321d16-359d-5e2f-95ab-b9760eab5e27.description:
## Mace of the Kingslayer (d8), 2 charges

- Hold the weapon aloft and shout an order or declaration. Any who fail a WIL save must obey, against their better judgment.
  - **Recharge**: Deliver a fatal blow to the leader of a group or faction.

attributes.charge_regain: Deliver a fatal blow to the leader of a group or faction.
attributes.effects: Hold the weapon aloft and shout an order or declaration. Any who fail a WIL save must obey, against their better judgment.

8a36cd53-2d56-5a9f-b59a-9e4b3aba6268.name: Moth Mirror, _bulky_
8a36cd53-2d56-5a9f-b59a-9e4b3aba6268.description:
## Moth Mirror, _bulky_

- A full-length, double-sided glass mirror. Step into the mirror to be transported to another mirror you know. You come out of the other side as an enormous swarm of buzzing moths, striking those around you with paralysis (WIL save to avoid) as they gaze upon you in horror. You can revert to your normal form at will. The mirror only operates in one direction.

attributes.effects: A full-length, double-sided glass mirror. Step into the mirror to be transported to another mirror you know. You come out of the other side as an enormous swarm of buzzing moths, striking those around you with paralysis (WIL save to avoid) as they gaze upon you in horror. You can revert to your normal form at will. The mirror only operates in one direction.

2bb59d45-8fc5-58ad-ab6d-e8fcb02b7680.name: Muffle Dust, 2 uses
2bb59d45-8fc5-58ad-ab6d-e8fcb02b7680.description:
## Muffle Dust, 2 uses

- A pouch of fine dust that muffles all sound in a 40ft radius when scattered.

attributes.effects: A pouch of fine dust that muffles all sound in a 40ft radius when scattered.

36df6100-c992-5843-b374-9cc8cf61b016.name: Nightstone, 1 use
36df6100-c992-5843-b374-9cc8cf61b016.description:
## Nightstone, 1 use

- Rare moon-shaped stones dredged from underwater caves and jungle dolines. Swallow whole to relieve all fatigue and deprivation as if you had a good night's sleep and a good meal. The stone will eventually pass through your system. It isn't fun.

attributes.effects: Rare moon-shaped stones dredged from underwater caves and jungle dolines. Swallow whole to relieve all fatigue and deprivation as if you had a good night's sleep and a good meal. The stone will eventually pass through your system. It isn't fun.

76e05778-1bdb-5568-8f03-dbca033ff926.name: Obliteration Scroll, 1 use, _petty_
76e05778-1bdb-5568-8f03-dbca033ff926.description:
## Obliteration Scroll, 1 use, _petty_

- A single-page document filled with gibberish. Sign anywhere on the page to remove any knowledge of your existence from this plane of reality. No one will know or remember you, and any references to your name or lineage will vanish. The scroll disappears in a puff of smoke that smells faintly of sulfur.

attributes.effects: A single-page document filled with gibberish. Sign anywhere on the page to remove any knowledge of your existence from this plane of reality. No one will know or remember you, and any references to your name or lineage will vanish. The scroll disappears in a puff of smoke that smells faintly of sulfur.

cf20262a-4713-5c06-812c-80f6dc73a9ed.name: Parliament's Promise, +1 Armor
cf20262a-4713-5c06-812c-80f6dc73a9ed.description:
## Parliament's Promise, +1 Armor

- A helmet in the form of an owl's head. Its wearer can twist their head around like an owl and can see in darkness with perfect clarity. While wearing the helm, the wearer loses the ability to speak, uttering only the simplest of cooing noises.

attributes.effects: A helmet in the form of an owl's head. Its wearer can twist their head around like an owl and can see in darkness with perfect clarity. While wearing the helm, the wearer loses the ability to speak, uttering only the simplest of cooing noises.

b92f7059-be88-5fac-8578-6f0cdf3adeba.name: Phoenix Ash, 1 use
b92f7059-be88-5fac-8578-6f0cdf3adeba.description:
## Phoenix Ash, 1 use

- Sprinkle over a corpse to resurrect the deceased. They return with full health but no memory of their past life.

attributes.effects: Sprinkle over a corpse to resurrect the deceased. They return with full health but no memory of their past life.

b9fd0f88-c9dc-5a8a-8847-b253e28438e1.name: Ring of the Snake, 1 charge, _petty_
b9fd0f88-c9dc-5a8a-8847-b253e28438e1.description:
## Ring of the Snake, 1 charge, _petty_

- A wrought-iron serpent ring. Place it on your finger and fall into a sleep so deep that most will think you are dead. If the ring is removed, you will awaken feeling refreshed. Otherwise, the effect will wear off after one month.
  - **Recharge**: Bury the ring with a corpse. A month later, exhume the corpse and retrieve it.

attributes.charge_regain: Bury the ring with a corpse. A month later, exhume the corpse and retrieve it.
attributes.effects: A wrought-iron serpent ring. Place it on your finger and fall into a sleep so deep that most will think you are dead. If the ring is removed, you will awaken feeling refreshed. Otherwise, the effect will wear off after one month.

44721f87-8bc8-5434-a1b4-ddfbc0b46241.name: Roc Feather, 1 use
44721f87-8bc8-5434-a1b4-ddfbc0b46241.description:
## Roc Feather, 1 use

- Hold while falling to float safely to the ground from any height.

attributes.effects: Hold while falling to float safely to the ground from any height.

4ef8dd94-a873-5d31-bc4d-245fe2f9c015.name: Skull Whistle, 3 charges
4ef8dd94-a873-5d31-bc4d-245fe2f9c015.description:
## Skull Whistle, 3 charges

- Produces a chilling scream that forces any who hear it (including the blower) to make a WIL save or become temporarily incapacitated.
  - **Recharge**: Feed the instrument a clump of human hair pulled from a living skull.

attributes.charge_regain: Feed the instrument a clump of human hair pulled from a living skull.
attributes.effects: Produces a chilling scream that forces any who hear it (including the blower) to make a WIL save or become temporarily incapacitated.

5b24ae69-a775-5a17-8199-a350776b08a4.name: Soul Clump
5b24ae69-a775-5a17-8199-a350776b08a4.description:
## Soul Clump

- A hard, fist-sized ball covered in small bumps. When rolled on a flat surface, it collects any objects smaller than its current mass, which subsequently increases as more items are attached to its surface. Only living creatures are immune.

attributes.effects: A hard, fist-sized ball covered in small bumps. When rolled on a flat surface, it collects any objects smaller than its current mass, which subsequently increases as more items are attached to its surface. Only living creatures are immune.

b6fa9769-7191-5314-9ea2-74caac07287f.name: Spystone, 1 charge
b6fa9769-7191-5314-9ea2-74caac07287f.description:
## Spystone, 1 charge

- A smooth, flat stone that is slightly warm to the touch. Squeeze to record audio in a 40ft radius. Squeeze again to play it back, as many times as you like.
  - **Recharge**: To record a new sound, skip the rock at least three times on a body of water and recover it.

attributes.charge_regain: To record a new sound, skip the rock at least three times on a body of water and recover it.
attributes.effects: A smooth, flat stone that is slightly warm to the touch. Squeeze to record audio in a 40ft radius. Squeeze again to play it back, as many times as you like.

9832db9b-be72-55bb-9018-c90058cb450b.name: Sticky Rope, 1 charge
9832db9b-be72-55bb-9018-c90058cb450b.description:
## Sticky Rope, 1 charge

- A 100ft rope that can stick to any surface.
  - **Recharge**: Cut off 10ft of rope, which then withers away.

attributes.charge_regain: Cut off 10ft of rope, which then withers away.
attributes.effects: A 100ft rope that can stick to any surface.

09fee041-177d-50ea-934e-4e6b0c61c2ed.name: Stone Eater, 1 use
09fee041-177d-50ea-934e-4e6b0c61c2ed.description:
## Stone Eater, 1 use

- A rodent-sized centipede that consumes and digests stone, capable of cutting a small tunnel in under an hour. It can be used more than once, but only if you can catch it (DEX 18).

attributes.effects: A rodent-sized centipede that consumes and digests stone, capable of cutting a small tunnel in under an hour. It can be used more than once, but only if you can catch it (DEX 18).

05656917-87d5-582b-9300-9c404a4f393a.name: Stonewax Gum, 3 uses, _petty_
05656917-87d5-582b-9300-9c404a4f393a.description:
## Stonewax Gum, 3 uses, _petty_

- Chew, then spit. The gum will harden and stretch, making a perfect, unbreakable seal.

attributes.effects: Chew, then spit. The gum will harden and stretch, making a perfect, unbreakable seal.

bc7aa6e9-d8eb-50ed-a981-4c1106d74318.name: Sponge Army, 1 use
bc7aa6e9-d8eb-50ed-a981-4c1106d74318.description:
## Sponge Army, 1 use

- A dozen miniature soldiers made of carved sea sponges. When splashed with water, they grow to full size [8 HP, 6 STR, 13 DEX, 5 WIL, hardened sponge (d6), _detachment_] and follow the orders of the person they see until they are destroyed or dry out completely (about 10 minutes).

attributes.effects: A dozen miniature soldiers made of carved sea sponges. When splashed with water, they grow to full size [8 HP, 6 STR, 13 DEX, 5 WIL, hardened sponge (d6), _detachment_] and follow the orders of the person they see until they are destroyed or dry out completely (about 10 minutes).

469c1cea-c5e0-5c9e-9b8c-21bd1ae4cb12.name: Tupshead Crown, +1 Armor, _bulky_
469c1cea-c5e0-5c9e-9b8c-21bd1ae4cb12.description:
## Tupshead Crown, +1 Armor, _bulky_

- A beautifully rendered ram's head helm wrought from tough alpine oak. The horns can be used as weapons (d6+d6).

attributes.effects: A beautifully rendered ram's head helm wrought from tough alpine oak. The horns can be used as weapons (d6+d6).

fa3d57db-4989-5136-95b8-896d279c0193.name: Veilsilk Grip, 1 charge, _petty_
fa3d57db-4989-5136-95b8-896d279c0193.description:
## Veilsilk Grip, 1 charge, _petty_

- A hand wearing this glove can phase through solid objects.
  - **Recharge**: Snip off one of the fingers.

attributes.charge_regain: Snip off one of the fingers.
attributes.effects: A hand wearing this glove can phase through solid objects.

d0d0af52-013a-5fd0-909f-5128ee3ce2b7.name: Voice of the Mountain, 1 use
d0d0af52-013a-5fd0-909f-5128ee3ce2b7.description:
## Voice of the Mountain, 1 use

- A rough pebble imbued with the essence of a mountain spirit. Crush to call forth an earthquake or similar natural disaster. Do not expect to be spared.

attributes.effects: A rough pebble imbued with the essence of a mountain spirit. Crush to call forth an earthquake or similar natural disaster. Do not expect to be spared.

8792f050-7db7-5cfc-a31d-a010f0090c3f.name: Ward Stone, 1 use
8792f050-7db7-5cfc-a31d-a010f0090c3f.description:
## Ward Stone, 1 use

- A flat, unassuming river stone notched with faded symbols. Smash to release a silvery powder in a 20ft radius that pacifies anyone who breathes it.

attributes.effects: A flat, unassuming river stone notched with faded symbols. Smash to release a silvery powder in a 20ft radius that pacifies anyone who breathes it.

b3db6f53-af71-536e-8624-26979b292237.name: Whispergale, 1 use
b3db6f53-af71-536e-8624-26979b292237.description:
## Whispergale, 1 use

- A balloon-shaped plant that captures a spoken message and delivers it to a location within a day's walk.

attributes.effects: A balloon-shaped plant that captures a spoken message and delivers it to a location within a day's walk.

ededc9e9-a760-57b8-8cb6-2ded09f8994a.name: Whistle-Rope
ededc9e9-a760-57b8-8cb6-2ded09f8994a.description:
## Whistle-Rope

- 15ft of highly flexible leather. Swirl in the air to generate a powerful subsonic effect that drives away wildlife. Also works underwater.

attributes.effects: 15ft of highly flexible leather. Swirl in the air to generate a powerful subsonic effect that drives away wildlife. Also works underwater.

6d002334-053d-5371-a456-0b17f328a578.name: Wonder Bar, 1 charge
6d002334-053d-5371-a456-0b17f328a578.description:
## Wonder Bar, 1 charge

- Pressing the switch on the side of this iron bar freezes it in place, even in midair. Once frozen, it cannot be moved by any force until the switch is depressed.
  - **Recharge**: Hold the bar with both hands without letting go for one continuous hour (WIL save to succeed). You can make only one attempt each day.

attributes.charge_regain: Hold the bar with both hands without letting go for one continuous hour (WIL save to succeed). You can make only one attempt each day.
attributes.effects: Pressing the switch on the side of this iron bar freezes it in place, even in midair. Once frozen, it cannot be moved by any force until the switch is depressed.

12b8d85e-472e-542d-adf3-52b842175880.name: Wraith Lantern, 1 charge
12b8d85e-472e-542d-adf3-52b842175880.description:
## Wraith Lantern, 1 charge

- Write someone's name onto its glass, and the name will disappear. The lantern reveals a path to their current location, visible only to the holder (day or night).
  - **Recharge**: Kill the last person found with the help of the lantern, trapping their spirit inside. The lantern must be nearby when they are killed.

attributes.charge_regain: Kill the last person found with the help of the lantern, trapping their spirit inside. The lantern must be nearby when they are killed.
attributes.effects: Write someone's name onto its glass, and the name will disappear. The lantern reveals a path to their current location, visible only to the holder (day or night).

db9aa10c-b846-5929-b2b9-2dd2b4705ce3.name: Adhere
db9aa10c-b846-5929-b2b9-2dd2b4705ce3.description: An object is covered in extremely sticky slime. _Adjacent objects stick to the book with great force._

21fda236-a88f-503e-997b-eb324e8ad5e1.name: Anchor
21fda236-a88f-503e-997b-eb324e8ad5e1.description: A strong wire sprouts from your arms, affixing itself to two points within 50ft on each side. _If a rope is pulled through the iron loop on its spine, it becomes as heavy as an elephant._

0d1a05ec-8480-5e83-b480-2ab9433d3652.name: Animate Object
0d1a05ec-8480-5e83-b480-2ab9433d3652.description: An object obeys your commands as best it can. _Moldable like clay. Childish laughter sprouts from its pages._

f18a2309-5790-54b6-864b-c1d523f58a33.name: Anthropomorphize
f18a2309-5790-54b6-864b-c1d523f58a33.description: An animal either gains human intelligence or human appearance for one day. _Whimpers, purrs and growls depending on its treatment._

e2b0299a-2862-53af-9f04-12df0f32cdad.name: Arcane Eye
e2b0299a-2862-53af-9f04-12df0f32cdad.description: You can see through a magical floating eyeball that flies around at your command. _Needs a spritz of water to open._

a288d8cd-6808-524d-a054-4a02c41b07ad.name: Astral Prison
a288d8cd-6808-524d-a054-4a02c41b07ad.description: An object is frozen in time and space within an invulnerable crystal shell. _Silent, abstract, faces scream in anguish within._

a3160de4-cbd7-5694-b882-bb127bfc14b9.name: Attract
a3160de4-cbd7-5694-b882-bb127bfc14b9.description: Two objects are strongly magnetically attracted to each other if they come within 10 feet. _Nearby compasses spin uselessly._

fd194b2b-7ae4-59aa-bffc-0fee53147060.name: Auditory Illusion
fd194b2b-7ae4-59aa-bffc-0fee53147060.description: You create illusory sounds that seem to come from a direction of your choice. _Produces random and occasionally inopportune sounds throughout the day_.

7da9d387-f326-5d57-a20f-a772cb8edb4a.name: Babble
7da9d387-f326-5d57-a20f-a772cb8edb4a.description: A creature must loudly and clearly repeat everything you think. It is otherwise mute. _When the text is read aloud, the words of others become unintelligible._

3aeedbda-ec5f-5417-b57c-9f378d4edfae.name: Bait Flower
3aeedbda-ec5f-5417-b57c-9f378d4edfae.description: A plant sprouts from the ground that emanates the smell of decaying flesh. _Attracts flies._

341a5851-69bb-54f1-87be-0273f2e05ef5.name: Beast Form
341a5851-69bb-54f1-87be-0273f2e05ef5.description: You and your possessions transform into a mundane animal. _Covered in thick fur, its edges lined with small teeth._

67579f44-5afa-5a51-9bff-e8cfc5f38d4c.name: Befuddle
67579f44-5afa-5a51-9bff-e8cfc5f38d4c.description: A creature of your choice is unable to form new short-term memories for the duration of the spell. _Its contents shift and change each time it is opened._

d713277d-cce2-500a-b191-8a88af5d99c0.name: Body Swap
d713277d-cce2-500a-b191-8a88af5d99c0.description: You switch bodies with a creature you touch. If one body dies, the other dies as well. _The front cover shows an image of the last creature to read it._

3429386c-b3ae-50fb-94f7-5d8467738d8d.name: Charm
3429386c-b3ae-50fb-94f7-5d8467738d8d.description: A creature you can see treats you as a friend. _Warm to the touch, and smells of roses._

3990a657-ecb4-5a7b-b95f-02299c17bf96.name: Command
3990a657-ecb4-5a7b-b95f-02299c17bf96.description: A target obeys a single three-word command that does not cause it harm. _Grows thinner over time, until finally disappearing forever._

e1655b30-ae7d-5fa5-8a61-d6611ce518a9.name: Comprehend
e1655b30-ae7d-5fa5-8a61-d6611ce518a9.description: You become fluent in all languages for a short while. _Drips letters, staining whatever it touches._

2d9d4d4e-ec8e-5ae9-b7c4-0b4d8e7c6e51.name: Cone of Foam
2d9d4d4e-ec8e-5ae9-b7c4-0b4d8e7c6e51.description: Dense foam sprays from your hand, coating the target. _Spongy and moist with a soapy residue._

3781577c-3b04-5862-a34d-7ce621798db8.name: Control Plants
3781577c-3b04-5862-a34d-7ce621798db8.description: Nearby plants and trees obey you and gain the ability to move at a slow pace. _Leaves grow along the spine, and it smells faintly of decay._

d48eea37-75c0-504e-a4e7-a199d957d1bc.name: Control Weather
d48eea37-75c0-504e-a4e7-a199d957d1bc.description: You may alter the type of weather at will, but you do not otherwise control it. _Highly resistant to fire and water damage._

f13347fc-3028-5c10-a501-d3d6c24057f4.name: Cure Wounds
f13347fc-3028-5c10-a501-d3d6c24057f4.description: Restore 1d4 STR per day to a creature you can touch. _Smells of vinegar and thyme. Turns red after use._

38fd342a-5f3b-5d5c-9620-e08d396bc82c.name: Deafen
38fd342a-5f3b-5d5c-9620-e08d396bc82c.description: All nearby creatures are deafened. _Nearby instruments occasionally sound off, as if in protest._

7d7484fa-f02d-5b93-98c8-dadc3cb1ffc4.name: Detect Magic
7d7484fa-f02d-5b93-98c8-dadc3cb1ffc4.description: You can see or hear nearby magical auras. _Becomes warm to the touch if magic is used nearby._

f0b006e6-6d4e-5bd7-8295-b9f6a694168f.name: Disassemble
f0b006e6-6d4e-5bd7-8295-b9f6a694168f.description: Any of your body parts may be detached and reattached at will, without causing pain or damage. You can still control them. _Regenerates any torn or defaced pages._

210dfed2-a812-544e-b047-f2f6c3faf633.name: Disguise
210dfed2-a812-544e-b047-f2f6c3faf633.description: You may alter the appearance of one character at will as long as they remain humanoid. Attempts to duplicate other characters will seem uncanny. _The surface makes a perfect mirror._

55c71505-4f33-5757-91d5-de31309f3872.name: Displace
55c71505-4f33-5757-91d5-de31309f3872.description: An object appears to be up to 15ft from its actual position. _Bits of string, clothing, and leaves are sometimes stuffed inside._

b37cb4b3-ed00-5c32-ab31-861bf83891a1.name: Earthquake
b37cb4b3-ed00-5c32-ab31-861bf83891a1.description: The ground begins shaking violently. Structures may be damaged or collapse. _Sand dribbles from the corners, seemingly without stop._

b5ac438c-5352-5ba9-8a40-2c23292ab149.name: Elasticity
b5ac438c-5352-5ba9-8a40-2c23292ab149.description: Your body can stretch up to 10ft. _Smells of taffy, and is very flexible._

55b597bd-979c-5145-9c47-bc625578ce6f.name: Elemental Wall
55b597bd-979c-5145-9c47-bc625578ce6f.description: A straight wall of ice or fire 50ft long and 10ft high rises from the ground. _Skin and warmer substances stick to it after use._

47db31f4-f7a6-572c-801c-18e05f6e8b1d.name: Filch
47db31f4-f7a6-572c-801c-18e05f6e8b1d.description: A visible item teleports to your hands. _An ally's prized possession may occasionally be found tucked between its covers_.

76ef72ae-192f-5f5c-bae6-7791a665f09d.name: Fish Lung
76ef72ae-192f-5f5c-bae6-7791a665f09d.description: A target can breathe underwater until they surface again. _Smells strongly of the sea. Attracts wild animals._

62655541-5f4b-534f-a2f3-f2c62ce1460a.name: Flare
62655541-5f4b-534f-a2f3-f2c62ce1460a.description: A bright ball of energy fires a trail of light into the sky, revealing your location to friend or foe. _Faintly glows in complete darkness_.

0a40c7b4-5c7d-5a73-ae78-eb23215d303e.name: Fog Cloud
0a40c7b4-5c7d-5a73-ae78-eb23215d303e.description: A dense fog spreads out from you. _When submersed in water, the book eventually turns all the liquid to vapor._

662e7197-5338-51fd-a334-a87fd1f0e4ad.name: Frenzy
662e7197-5338-51fd-a334-a87fd1f0e4ad.description: A nearby creature erupts in a frenzy of violence. _Rough, sandpaper cover that destroys any book it touches._

9826afe7-b899-53d9-bf16-7ac672ef3f79.name: Gate
9826afe7-b899-53d9-bf16-7ac672ef3f79.description: A portal to a random plane opens. _A large hole is carved into the center, ending in a void. Items dropped within are never seen again_.

a0d9c468-92f9-5453-a0f2-54e5fe85ad4e.name: Gravity Shift
a0d9c468-92f9-5453-a0f2-54e5fe85ad4e.description: You can change the direction of gravity, but only for yourself. _Attaches itself to the largest object nearby._

90dc4a4a-5f75-5678-90f1-e4248a83946a.name: Greed
90dc4a4a-5f75-5678-90f1-e4248a83946a.description: A creature develops the overwhelming urge to possess a visible item of your choice. _The cover changes depending on the owner, subtly hinting at their deepest desires._

26c27328-4833-5977-98b4-65974763ec61.name: Haste
26c27328-4833-5977-98b4-65974763ec61.description: Your movement speed is tripled. _Pages flip wildly while open. Can cause paper cuts._

2c6e0cff-c619-5c3e-b8b9-f0d06979c536.name: Hatred
2c6e0cff-c619-5c3e-b8b9-f0d06979c536.description: A creature develops a deep hatred of another creature or group and wishes to destroy them. _Long term exposure to the book can cause suspicion, paranoia and distrust of others._

36319450-7023-516a-963b-da451133ff45.name: Hear Whispers
36319450-7023-516a-963b-da451133ff45.description: You can hear faint sounds clearly. _The reader's voice is amplified for a short period of time afterwards._

8ea27ef6-180f-5af6-93ee-2795dfd35d61.name: Hover
8ea27ef6-180f-5af6-93ee-2795dfd35d61.description: An object hovers, frictionless, 2ft above the ground. It can hold up to one humanoid. _Floats if dropped._

05a5e230-e8d5-5635-8879-4eb746539952.name: Hypnotize
05a5e230-e8d5-5635-8879-4eb746539952.description: A creature enters a trance and will truthfully answer one yes or no question you ask it. _Eye-catching, swirling spirals don its covers._

e2a3fd7e-02fb-5cdd-8e56-6fbee67fb173.name: Icy Touch
e2a3fd7e-02fb-5cdd-8e56-6fbee67fb173.description: A thick ice layer spreads across a touched surface, up to 10ft in radius. _Gloves required. Nonflammable_.

753ba0ea-a105-507a-bbe9-71c3e81444d7.name: Identify Owner
753ba0ea-a105-507a-bbe9-71c3e81444d7.description: Letters appear over the object you touch, spelling out the name of the object’s owners, if there are any. _The book's interior lists the name of its previous owner._

353dbd69-40f5-5844-88af-2f459390ed2b.name: Illuminate
353dbd69-40f5-5844-88af-2f459390ed2b.description: A floating light moves as you command. _When held in light, the pages become a prism of vibrant rainbows._

fdc6b9ff-b3c5-5862-9622-45fbec04b4fd.name: Invisible Tether
fdc6b9ff-b3c5-5862-9622-45fbec04b4fd.description: Two objects within 10ft of each other cannot be moved more than 10ft apart. _Its pages are not attached by glue or thread, yet stay together nonetheless._

e981d28d-f018-54d8-9ce9-36fdb853f192.name: Knock
e981d28d-f018-54d8-9ce9-36fdb853f192.description: A nearby mundane or magical lock unlocks loudly. _Locked. A new owner "produces" the key after their next meal._

ff8f655e-0720-51cd-9db5-efe77a780b81.name: Leap
ff8f655e-0720-51cd-9db5-efe77a780b81.description: You jump up to 10ft high, once. _When thrown, it just keeps going._

4a208420-87a9-5334-bbab-c88eed255c2e.name: Liquid Air
4a208420-87a9-5334-bbab-c88eed255c2e.description: The air around you becomes swimmable. _Floats of its own volition, bouncing off of whatever it touches._

4e1b8f77-8da1-505f-87d4-f2eb1959334e.name: Magic Dampener
4e1b8f77-8da1-505f-87d4-f2eb1959334e.description: All nearby magical effects have their effectiveness halved. _Relics within 100ft of the spellbook cannot be recharged._

9863c4bb-60ac-5e0e-90df-5410b0235ce9.name: Manse
9863c4bb-60ac-5e0e-90df-5410b0235ce9.description: A sturdy, furnished cottage appears for hours. You can permit and forbid entry to it at will. _If left inside, both the book and the cottage vanish forever._

6b2f8772-9a25-54cb-9d0a-f711c8130d82.name: Marble Craze
6b2f8772-9a25-54cb-9d0a-f711c8130d82.description: Your pockets are full of marbles and will refill every 30 seconds. _When jostled, makes a playful rattling sound._

9591c693-3c40-57fb-91f7-63d83bec30c1.name: Masquerade
9591c693-3c40-57fb-91f7-63d83bec30c1.description: A character's appearance and voice becomes identical to those of a character you touch. _Extended use causes the owner to develop unconscious yet noticeable tics._

6cb3e79b-9f44-5716-81a0-834ed4fddeea.name: Miniaturize
6cb3e79b-9f44-5716-81a0-834ed4fddeea.description: A creature you touch is shrunk down to the size of a mouse. _The text is ludicrously, comically large._

fda6475e-1c81-5860-9d55-4bbd91df761f.name: Mirror Image
fda6475e-1c81-5860-9d55-4bbd91df761f.description: An illusory duplicate of yourself appears and is under your control. _Over time, the owner begins to question who is the original, and who is the duplicate._

75c8de49-d8b9-591f-ac6c-0c3dcdf43049.name: Mirrorwalk
75c8de49-d8b9-591f-ac6c-0c3dcdf43049.description: A mirror becomes a gateway to another mirror that you looked into today. _Will not open unless the owner politely knocks on the cover._

2075ce15-26b8-5815-8e4e-5a760c81ebae.name: Multiarm
2075ce15-26b8-5815-8e4e-5a760c81ebae.description: You temporarily gain an extra arm. _After use, the caster is wracked with phantom limb syndrome for a day._

606405f4-59b4-530a-bd54-970c868fb8aa.name: Night Sphere
606405f4-59b4-530a-bd54-970c868fb8aa.description: A 50ft-wide sphere of darkness displaying the night sky appears before you. _Displays a prominent constellation on its cover_.

a6f24643-78de-51d1-8621-6731f877b923.name: Objectify
a6f24643-78de-51d1-8621-6731f877b923.description: You become any inanimate object between the size of a grand piano and an apple. _The owner experiences intense pareidolia for days after use._

4f724268-9508-5518-9171-c726de54133a.name: Ooze Form
4f724268-9508-5518-9171-c726de54133a.description: You become a living jelly. _Slowly drips an acid that eventually eats away anything it touches._

e59e8d9a-a8bf-5fc2-9786-013132f80074.name: Pacify
e59e8d9a-a8bf-5fc2-9786-013132f80074.description: A creature near you has an aversion to violence. _Smells of jasmine and incense. Attracts children._

729f6dcb-0cc2-5c3e-9955-0e5d5a2e2c68.name: Passage
729f6dcb-0cc2-5c3e-9955-0e5d5a2e2c68.description: Creates a temporary path through wood, stone or brick. _An object dropped on top of the book inevitably falls through the other side._

411e9c4e-c949-5f74-bde3-f22b647184bf.name: Phobia
411e9c4e-c949-5f74-bde3-f22b647184bf.description: A nearby creature becomes terrified of an object of your choice. _Over time, haunting, abstract art begins to fill its pages._

bf0700b1-01f1-5b0b-923c-55c437b7c1f5.name: Pit
bf0700b1-01f1-5b0b-923c-55c437b7c1f5.description: A pit 10ft wide and 10ft deep opens in the ground. _A standard piton can be safely stored in its spine_.

fdb3d656-834e-5693-ba2f-c1563490c09d.name: Primal Surge
fdb3d656-834e-5693-ba2f-c1563490c09d.description: A creature rapidly evolves into a future version of its species. _The owner is haunted by strange visions of their own ancestors._

25ab8bf3-849c-5bf7-9af8-1996188d0e2f.name: Push/Pull
25ab8bf3-849c-5bf7-9af8-1996188d0e2f.description: An object of any size is pulled directly towards you or pushed directly away from you with the strength of one man. _Any force against the book is comically amplified._

9a1d0cb0-ee5c-575e-9dda-4f9f3d7ad5db.name: Raise Dead
9a1d0cb0-ee5c-575e-9dda-4f9f3d7ad5db.description: A skeleton rises from the ground to serve you. They are incredibly stupid and can only obey simple orders. _The owner becomes more and more fascinated with bones after each use._

f41b4295-cd30-5bd2-9c2a-d6d9c79c937c.name: Raise Spirit
f41b4295-cd30-5bd2-9c2a-d6d9c79c937c.description: The spirit of a nearby corpse manifests and will answer 1 question. _The answers (but not their questions) are forever inscribed in its pages._

bdae56b1-ac66-5149-b997-4c6ea369cedf.name: Read Mind
bdae56b1-ac66-5149-b997-4c6ea369cedf.description: You can hear the surface thoughts of nearby creatures. _Long-term possession can cause the reader to mistake the thoughts of others as their own._

521b0d47-b3ff-5d78-8401-045c64a9b229.name: Repel
521b0d47-b3ff-5d78-8401-045c64a9b229.description: Two objects are strongly magnetically repelled from each other within 10 feet. _Closed by two powerful straps that spring open at inopportune times._

c0a07cb0-77b3-5f0f-95f5-47a6a71666ad.name: Scry
c0a07cb0-77b3-5f0f-95f5-47a6a71666ad.description: You can see through the eyes of a creature you touched earlier today. _The owner's eyes turn milky-white for an hour after use._

edc3f8fd-ddcc-5a00-b8b3-1f83fd9bb77a.name: Sculpt Elements
edc3f8fd-ddcc-5a00-b8b3-1f83fd9bb77a.description: Inanimate material behaves like clay in your hands. _Slowly decays on contact with wood or cloth. Bury in dirt or submerge in water to refresh._

af94941d-78d2-528e-82b9-30d6d7cb8ac5.name: Sense
af94941d-78d2-528e-82b9-30d6d7cb8ac5.description: Choose one kind of object (key, gold, arrow, jug, etc). You can sense the nearest example. _The book's previous owner is always aware of the book's current location._

27554fd0-f3b0-58b5-aef5-f93b1efff088.name: Shield
27554fd0-f3b0-58b5-aef5-f93b1efff088.description: A creature you touch is protected from mundane attacks for one minute. _Bound in rusty ring-mail and is quite heavy. If held, provides +1 Armor._

77fc17ae-0d2c-524c-9499-85cf424e9150.name: Shroud
77fc17ae-0d2c-524c-9499-85cf424e9150.description: A creature you touch is invisible until they move. _Invisible to any but the book's current owner._

7d9909d1-5615-5911-8ea2-e7abd84660d3.name: Shuffle
7d9909d1-5615-5911-8ea2-e7abd84660d3.description: Two creatures you can see instantly switch places. _If stolen but not yet read, it reappears wherever its owner last left it._

2698b00e-4a5c-59b4-b00f-7a6f03216092.name: Skillful Repair
2698b00e-4a5c-59b4-b00f-7a6f03216092.description: You make minor repairs to a nonliving object. _Sewn from the vellum of one hundred books, no two pages are alike._

8a1810ea-70a6-5802-9472-47921b7e4e1c.name: Sleep
8a1810ea-70a6-5802-9472-47921b7e4e1c.description: A creature you can see falls into a light sleep. _Soft as a pillow, but yields only fitful sleep._

a50e6d0d-e203-5518-8cb2-9bf6389bc9c8.name: Slick
a50e6d0d-e203-5518-8cb2-9bf6389bc9c8.description: Every surface in a 30ft radius becomes extremely slippery. _Gloves are required for handling, lest the book is dropped in a most comical fashion._

95db9497-0847-510e-8576-416a1d42ed59.name: Smoke Form
95db9497-0847-510e-8576-416a1d42ed59.description: Your body becomes a living smoke that you can control. _Smells of campfire. The pages cannot be burnt, but are very sensitive to moisture._

8623dca0-d7eb-5a3e-93a8-850a458b525e.name: Sniff
8623dca0-d7eb-5a3e-93a8-850a458b525e.description: You can smell even the faintest traces of scents. _Expresses a strong odor detectable only by its owner._

c1d5293e-9e38-5e26-9f81-af7b26f0e831.name: Snuff
c1d5293e-9e38-5e26-9f81-af7b26f0e831.description: The source of any mundane light you can see is instantly snuffed out. _If left in one place for long periods, nearby light sources eventually dim, then finally go out._

5b193419-33bb-56c8-a873-ce14a1b31bbb.name: Sort
5b193419-33bb-56c8-a873-ce14a1b31bbb.description: Inanimate items sort themselves according to categories you set. _Rights itself when dropped or thrown._

2aadcc67-933e-5710-833d-43a234a95b13.name: Spellsaw
2aadcc67-933e-5710-833d-43a234a95b13.description: A whirling blade flies from your chest, clearing any plant material in its way. It is otherwise harmless. _Wrapped in stained leather, it should be oiled at least once a month_.

5b58f5eb-b433-5b1c-8a65-4dbaedc6ec42.name: Spider Climb
5b58f5eb-b433-5b1c-8a65-4dbaedc6ec42.description: You can climb surfaces like a spider. _New cobwebs must be pushed aside prior to each use. They are hard to remove._

ad98b5ff-fc06-5eef-8d73-84be00ff6fd0.name: Swarm
ad98b5ff-fc06-5eef-8d73-84be00ff6fd0.description: You become a swarm of crows, rats, or piranhas. You can only be harmed by _blast_ attacks. _Easily broken into a dozen distinct parts that slowly move towards one another over time._

6f155305-7afd-58de-b198-2315ccefb2e4.name: Target Lure
6f155305-7afd-58de-b198-2315ccefb2e4.description: An object you touch becomes the target of any nearby spell. _Attracts all manner of magical creatures, spell leaks, and scrying._

72731bc3-6dee-5517-8f33-334dece46fb9.name: Telekinesis
72731bc3-6dee-5517-8f33-334dece46fb9.description: You may mentally 1 move item under 60lbs. _The owner can summon the book through mental command alone (WIL save or become deprived afterwards)._

1ba1624b-14ca-5269-95c3-eb392ebb0606.name: Telepathy
1ba1624b-14ca-5269-95c3-eb392ebb0606.description: Two creatures can hear each other’s thoughts, no matter how far apart. _The holder can hear (but not respond) to the thoughts of whoever last possessed it, and vice versa._

5d02aac3-65c7-568f-9921-385e9f65939d.name: Teleport
5d02aac3-65c7-568f-9921-385e9f65939d.description: An object or person you can see is transported from one place to another in a 50ft radius. _Can be destroyed to create a portal to another dimension._

0a1ce406-768d-5622-a079-d9b5e481fc24.name: Thicket
0a1ce406-768d-5622-a079-d9b5e481fc24.description: A thicket of trees and dense brush up to 50ft wide suddenly sprouts up. _Wrapped in vines that must be destroyed again with each use._

63e14226-2151-50b1-aefc-b5a6dfc66c23.name: Time Control
63e14226-2151-50b1-aefc-b5a6dfc66c23.description: Time in a 50ft bubble slows down or increases by 10% for 30 seconds. _Alternates its appearance as either impossibly old or freshly written._

247d8031-ec75-5fca-95c1-bc845ab19738.name: True Sight
247d8031-ec75-5fca-95c1-bc845ab19738.description: You see through all nearby illusions. _Cannot be concealed by magic, and sticks out like a sore thumb._

6b66a0a4-e903-5176-afe1-b04fb602755d.name: Upwell
6b66a0a4-e903-5176-afe1-b04fb602755d.description: A spring of seawater appears. _Hardened leather bindings caked in salt and living barnacles._

901539a1-80ab-5356-b227-51641ecd5230.name: Vision
901539a1-80ab-5356-b227-51641ecd5230.description: You completely control what a creature sees. _An unnerving, lidless eye graces the front cover._

cedb7e04-167d-5a6a-a940-0a7dcfcd60cb.name: Visual Illusion
cedb7e04-167d-5a6a-a940-0a7dcfcd60cb.description: A silent, immobile, room-sized illusion of your choice appears. _Filled with rich, colorful pages very much like a children's bedtime story._

120b5776-3cb2-57e3-9c0d-44ed93fe97cd.name: Ward
120b5776-3cb2-57e3-9c0d-44ed93fe97cd.description: A silver circle 50ft across appears on the ground. Choose one species that cannot cross it. _The covers are decorated with bizarre, otherworldly creatures with thousands of eyes._

8553923d-3812-5fb6-8c27-b28828a8b34f.name: Web
8553923d-3812-5fb6-8c27-b28828a8b34f.description: Your wrists shoot thick webbing. _The text is alien, yet somehow intelligible, for it is the language of dreams._

81a9676d-bd33-5d48-b7d5-66334f28d610.name: Widget
81a9676d-bd33-5d48-b7d5-66334f28d610.description: A primitive version of a drawn tool or item appears before you and disappears after a short time. _Smells of iron and rust, sweat and effort. Faint sounds of harsh labor emanate from deep within its pages._

1327e24c-e92c-56b2-a51b-3866d4dc3bf7.name: Wizard Mark
1327e24c-e92c-56b2-a51b-3866d4dc3bf7.description: Your finger can shoot a stream of ulfire-colored paint. This paint is only visible to you and can be seen at any distance, even through solid objects. _Inside the front cover is a small pocket containing a thin pad of paper, listing the name and date of death of all previous owners._

375bb783-5ecd-5067-b071-fc9606d28c36.name: X-Ray Vision
375bb783-5ecd-5067-b071-fc9606d28c36.description: You can see through walls, dirt, clothing, etc. _Long-term exposure can cause hair loss, blurry vision, and fatigue._
